result.title: Inside AI Tokenomics: Profitably Turn Tokens Into Business Value
result.description:
Token economics determine whether your AI scales or stalls. 
Shruti Koparkar from our Accelerated Computing team breaks down each tokenomics pillar on the NVIDIA AI podcast:

➡️ Utility — What is the optimal token value for your use case?
➡️ Demand — What is the volume of tokens the use case needs?
➡️ Supply — How to maximize token output and minimize token cost?
➡️ Monetization — How to turn tokens into revenue and profit?

🎧 Listen to the podcast: https://nvda.ws/4wFLYHg
